scenes.title: Trémouls Arches and the Vigan Portal of the Grand Tournant Tunnel
scenes.description: A photograph by A. Bonnaud, dated 1896, showing arches and a tunnel head of the Grand Tournant souterrain, part of the railways and tunnels of the Compagnie des chemins de fer du Midi. It is held by the Ecole nationale des ponts et chaussées.
scenes.explanation: Telescoping selfie sticks did not exist in 1896, so this object could not be present in the photograph.

scenes.title: German lieutenant [wounded] taken prisoner
scenes.description: Lieutenant allemand [blessé] fait prisonnier · Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica).
scenes.explanation: Flexible plastic IV fluid bags did not exist in 1918; battlefield fluids were given from glass bottles or enamelware, so a clear plastic pouch cannot belong to this scene.

scenes.title: Voorstraat
scenes.description: A photograph taken in 1962 on Voorstraat. The record credits Europeana, document number 081947, under a CC BY-SA license.
scenes.explanation: Moulded plastic fuel cans with screw caps did not exist in 1962; portable fuel containers of that era were metal.

scenes.title: Street in Stavanger
scenes.description: A photograph titled Gate i Stavanger, showing a gate in Stavanger, held by the National Library of Norway and dated 1900. The record lists the image as public domain and does not name a photographer.
scenes.explanation: The plastic hula hoop was not invented until 1958, so it cannot appear in a photograph taken in 1900.
scenes.credit: Skarpmoen, Narve via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Spanish Helicopter
scenes.description: A press photograph from 1923, taken by Agence Meurisse, showing a helicopter. It is held by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie.
scenes.explanation: Multi-rotor drones did not exist in 1923, so a hovering quadcopter could not appear in this photograph.
